claims.claim: Current evidence supports improving operating leverage but not demand acceleration of the same magnitude; efficiency gains should therefore not be treated as proof that the AI/exposure narrative is monetizing rapidly.

Competitive substitution and customer security-stack consolidation are credible present risks, while missing customer-level attribution for AI-native capabilities is an uncertainty rather than a blocker.

risks: moderate revenue growth relative to platform narrative
non-GAAP profitability can overstate economic improvement if excluded costs remain material
repurchases can improve per-share optics without organic acceleration
contradictions: Profitability is expanding faster than revenue; this can be healthy operating leverage but falsifies any assumption that current margin improvement alone proves accelerating category demand.
unknowns: organic bookings contribution of AI Exposure/Hexa
improvementPaths: publish or evidence durable platform expansion/retention
demonstrate customer-level outcomes and recurring bookings from newer AI/exposure capabilities

recommendation.reason: Red-team work is complete; existing growth-versus-narrative contradictions can be dispositioned with Alpha underwriting rather than treated as automatic blockers.
